$comment: Configuration for the Compass knowledge pipeline (raw + docs/specs -> Compass -> Obsidian -> OKF). Separate from knowledge-config.json (graphify) by design: never read implicitly by the graphify pipeline. The /generate-llm-wiki-compass and /publish-llm-wiki-compass commands, the compass-keeper agent, scripts/kb_active.py, scripts/compass_config_gen.py, scripts/compass_graph_adapter.py and scripts/compass_graph_check.py read from here.
$comment_compass_version: Measured on 2026-10-29; see docs/sdd/compass-verification.md. Preflight refuses a binary older than compass_min_version.
$comment_graph_json: Consumers read graph_json. compass_graph_json is the raw Compass output; the adapter writes graph_json in the shape cag_context.py expects (id/label/source_file + edges).
$comment_compass_build: Update runs without --out: Compass defaults to compass-out. semantic_extraction is off: the pipeline is structural and zero-token by default; enabling a backend consumes tokens and network.
$comment_compass_config_file: .compass/config.toml is generated by scripts/compass_config_gen.py from include/exclude above. Never run `compass init` on this repo (empty corpus fails with exit 2).
$comment_publication_exclude: Repo-relative prefixes removed from the git index after staging. Compass cache, snapshots and store are regenerable and must not be published.
